title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-117-26二模

items.zh: 邻家小男孩每天练习拉小提琴,十分勤奋。
items.en: The boy next door practices the violin diligently every day.

items.zh: 与其不假思索就仓促执行,不如事先仔细做好任务规划。
items.en: It is better to plan ahead carefully than to act hastily and unthinkingly.

items.zh: 随着春天的到来,这些饱受困苦的鹿再次向北迁徙,将狼群与森林抛在身后
items.en: With the arrival of spring, the hard-pressed deer head north once more, leaving the wolves and forests behind.

items.zh: 这些陆地上的冰偕同海冰,将太阳辐射反射出地表,以此保护我们的星球,防止其出现过热的状况。
items.en: The ice on land, together with sea ice, reflects solar radiation back into space, protecting our planet from overheating.
